headerGuide.title: Column information
headerGuide.netFlow: Net real money flow on the signal date equals individual investors' buy value minus their sell value.
headerGuide.zScore: Z-Score = (Net real money flow on the signal date − Average net flow over the previous {{days}} trading days) ÷ Standard deviation of net flow over the same period. Higher scores indicate more unusual activity.
headerGuide.flowMultiple: Net real money inflow on the signal date divided by the average absolute net flow over the previous {{days}} trading days. Outflow days are also included in the average.
headerGuide.tradeValueMultiple: Trading value on the signal date divided by the average trading value over the previous {{days}} trading days.
headerGuide.priceChange: Percentage price change from the start of the lookback period to the signal date, not the one-day price change. Capital-increase-adjusted prices are used when valid adjustment data is available.
headerGuide.hint: Click the i icon next to a column to see its explanation.
headerGuide.lookbackDays: Number of previous trading days used to calculate average money flow, standard deviation, and average trading value. The default is 20 trading days.
